title: Chipotle x 2XKO Tag Team Event Promo
description: Enter code TAGTEAM at digital checkout to receive exclusive in-game rewards (Chipotle Fresh Fit Bundle) in Riot Games' 2XKO and unlock chances to earn Free Dips (Guac/Queso), Chips & Dip, or Buy-One-Get-One (BOGO) Free Entrée coupons!
sf_details: Confirmed active for all 8 San Francisco locations (including Sutter St, 50 California St, and Metreon). Applicable only on the official Chipotle App or Chipotle.com. Supplies are capped at 40,000 uses nationwide, so apply early!
beginner_guide:
1. Open the Chipotle App or Chipotle.com.
2. Set your store location to any of the 8 SF branches (e.g., 50 California St).
3. Add a regular-priced entrée item to your bag.
4. Go to checkout, expand 'Promo Code', enter 'TAGTEAM', and tap apply.
5. You will receive your 2XKO items and your digital ticket for the free food drop!

title: Chipotle Honey Chicken + $0 Delivery Fee
description: Chipotle's record-breaking, sweet and spicy ('swicy') Chipotle Honey Chicken protein is back on the menu! Order any entrée containing Honey Chicken through the official app or website and enjoy a $0 delivery fee.
sf_details: Available at all San Francisco locations. Note that while there is a $0 delivery fee, higher menu prices are charged for delivery and local SF health/mandate fees still apply at checkout in CA.
beginner_guide:
1. Go to Chipotle's online menu and select 'Delivery'.
2. Pin your San Francisco delivery address.
3. Build your bowl, burrito, or quesadilla and select 'Chipotle Honey Chicken' as your protein.
4. The $0 delivery fee will automatically apply to your cart at checkout. No promo code needed!

title: Summer of Extras 2026: Earn a Free Entrée
description: Chipotle's Summer of Extras program is active for June, July, and August 2026! Opt-in via your rewards account and complete your order streaks. Upon hitting Milestone 7 this month, select a FREE Entrée Reward or 1,625 points.
sf_details: Valid for all Chipotle Rewards members ordering from any San Francisco location. Must be logged into your account to count toward your August streak.
beginner_guide:
1. Open your Chipotle App and go to the 'Rewards' tab.
2. Look for 'Summer of Extras 2026' and tap 'Opt In'.
3. Order your favorite meals (minimum $10) throughout August.
4. Track your milestones in the app to claim your free meal!

title: 50% Off Chipotle Orders on DoorDash
description: Get a huge 50% discount on your Chipotle order when checking out on DoorDash using the special promo code. Perfect for a quick, cheap meal delivered straight to your door.
sf_details: Valid for DoorDash deliveries originating from participating San Francisco Chipotle locations. This promo is active and expires on August 8, 2026. Limit one use per account.
beginner_guide:
1. Open the DoorDash App or website.
2. Search for 'Chipotle' and select the nearest SF location (e.g., Metreon or Geary Blvd).
3. Add your favorite items to your cart.
4. Proceed to checkout, paste 'DDCHIP50' in the promo code field, and enjoy 50% off!

title: $10 Off Your First Digital Order
description: Create a new Chipotle Rewards account and receive a $10 discount on your first digital order of $15 or more. A great way for beginners to try Chipotle's digital checkout.
sf_details: Valid for new digital accounts at all 8 San Francisco branches. Orders must be placed via the Chipotle App or Chipotle.com for pickup or delivery.
beginner_guide:
1. Download the Chipotle App or go to Chipotle.com.
2. Register a new account with your email.
3. Add at least $15 of food to your cart (e.g., one burrito bowl and chips & guac).
4. In the checkout screen, enter 'TRY10' in the promo code section to subtract $10.

title: Free Quesadilla on Orders of $20+
description: Enter the promo code at checkout on Chipotle's website or app to get a free hand-crafted Quesadilla added to your order of $20 or more.
sf_details: Active at participating locations in San Francisco. Excludes third-party delivery apps. The order subtotal must be $20 or more before tax and the quesadilla is added.
beginner_guide:
1. Order online on the Chipotle app or site.
2. Choose any SF pickup location.
3. Add at least $20 of other food (e.g., two burritos) to your cart.
4. Add a hand-crafted Quesadilla to your cart.
5. Enter code '025' at checkout to drop the Quesadilla's cost to $0.

title: 80¢ Boneless Wings (Mondays & Tuesdays)
description: Get delicious, crispy, sauced-and-tossed boneless wings for only 80 cents each (recently adjusted from 70 cents due to CA inflation) every Monday and Tuesday! No promo code required.
sf_details: Verified active at all 4 SF locations (1200 Market St, 60 Morris St, Lakeshore Plaza, and Charter Oak Ave). In San Francisco, due to local operating costs, the deal is 80¢ per wing (some national markets are still 70¢). Valid on 10, 15, or 20-count a la carte orders.
beginner_guide:
1. Order on a Monday or Tuesday via Wingstop.com, the Wingstop App, or walk-in.
2. Choose one of the 4 SF locations.
3. Go to 'Wings' and select 'Boneless Wings' in a count of 10, 15, or 20.
4. Choose your flavors (e.g., Lemon Pepper, Garlic Parmesan, or Mango Habanero).
5. Look at your cart subtotal: the wings will automatically discount to 80¢ each!

title: 20% Off Your Entire Wingstop Order
description: Save an extra 20% on your entire order at Wingstop when you spend $15 or more. Works on all wings, tenders, fries, and drinks.
sf_details: Valid at all 4 San Francisco locations for digital orders placed via Wingstop.com or the official Wingstop App. Requires a minimum order of $15 before tax and service fees.
beginner_guide:
1. Open Wingstop.com or the Wingstop App.
2. Set your store to the nearest SF location (e.g., 1200 Market St).
3. Add at least $15 of wings, fries, and dips to your order.
4. In the checkout screen, locate the 'Promo Code' box, enter 'WING2026', and click apply.

title: $19.99 All-In Bundle (Great Value Menu Deal)
description: Get a massive feast including 16-Piece Boneless or Bone-In Wings (up to 4 flavors), 6-Piece Crispy Tenders, Large Fries, and 3 Dips (like Wingstop's famous homemade Ranch) for just $19.99!
sf_details: Available for carryout or delivery at all 4 San Francisco locations. Prices in San Francisco may show as $21.99 due to regional CA cost adjustments, which is still an exceptional 35% savings over ordering items individually.
beginner_guide:
1. Go to Wingstop.com or the app.
2. Choose any SF location for carryout or delivery.
3. Go to the 'Deals' or 'Combos' tab on the menu.
4. Click on the 'All-In Bundle'.
5. Select your wing style, customize up to 4 delicious flavors, choose your dips, and add to bag. The discount is built-in!

title: 5 Free Boneless Wings with Wednesday Order
description: Order any wing combo on a Wednesday and get 5 completely free boneless wings added to your order with this exclusive new user coupon code.
sf_details: Valid on Wednesdays only at participating SF locations. Requires a new digital account on the Wingstop app. Minimum purchase of a regular wing combo is required.
beginner_guide:
1. Create a new account on the Wingstop App on a Wednesday.
2. Set your store to any of the 4 SF locations.
3. Add any standard Wing Combo (including wings, fries, and a drink) to your cart.
4. Add a 5-piece a la carte Boneless Wings order to your cart.
5. Apply promo code 'R5BW' at checkout to make the 5 boneless wings free!

title: Free Regular Fries on Orders $20+
description: Get a free order of Wingstop's freshly cut, seasoned regular fries (a $4 value) when you place an order of $20 or more and use the active coupon code.
sf_details: Verified at participating SF Wingstop stores. The cart subtotal must be at least $20 before adding the fries. Valid for online carryout orders only.
beginner_guide:
1. Order online on the Wingstop website or app for SF pickup.
2. Build an order worth $20 or more (e.g., a 15-piece wing group pack).
3. Add a 'Regular Fries' to your cart.
4. Go to checkout, type in 'IES' in the promo code box, and apply it. Your fries will show as $0.00!
